questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The instantaneous power delivered by a force F to a body moving with velocity v in the direction of the force is:
questions.explanation: Power is the rate of doing work, P = dW/dt = F·v. This is why a vehicle's engine can pull hard at low speed or run fast at low force, but not both at once.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 11, Chapter 5: Work, Energy and Power

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: According to Kepler's third law, the square of the period of revolution of a planet is proportional to:
options: The cube of the semi-major axis of the orbit
The square of the orbital speed
questions.explanation: T² ∝ a³, so a planet farther from the Sun takes much longer to complete one revolution. The law follows from Newton's law of gravitation.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: When a dielectric medium of dielectric constant K is introduced between two point charges, the electrostatic force between them becomes:
questions.explanation: F = q₁q₂/(4πε₀K r²), so any medium weakens the force. For water K is about 80, which is why ionic salts dissociate so readily in it.
questions.ncertReference: Physics Class 12, Chapter 1: Electric Charges and Fields

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The series of lines in the hydrogen spectrum that lies in the visible region is the:
questions.explanation: The Balmer series arises from transitions ending at n = 2. Lyman lines lie in the ultraviolet and Paschen and higher series in the infrared.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 2: Structure of Atom

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.topic: Organic Chemistry: Some Basic Principles and Techniques
questions.question: The breaking of a covalent bond in which each of the two atoms retains one electron of the shared pair is called:
questions.explanation: Homolysis needs non-polar conditions such as heat, light or peroxides and gives neutral radicals. Heterolysis gives a cation and an anion instead.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 8: Organic Chemistry: Some Basic Principles and Techniques

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: In aqueous solution at its isoelectric point, an amino acid exists mainly as a:
options: Zwitterion carrying both a positive and a negative charge
questions.explanation: The carboxyl group donates its proton to the amino group within the same molecule, so the ion has no net charge. This explains the high melting points of amino acids.

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: Pneumatophores, the roots that grow vertically upwards out of the mud, are found in:
questions.explanation: Mangrove soil is waterlogged and poor in oxygen, so these roots come above the surface to let the root system breathe. Banyan has prop roots and maize stilt roots.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 5: Morphology of Flowering Plants

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: A high biochemical oxygen demand (BOD) of a water sample indicates:
options: A large amount of organic matter and hence heavy pollution
questions.explanation: BOD measures the oxygen that bacteria need to break down the organic matter in a sample, so more organic waste means a higher BOD and less oxygen for aquatic life.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 12, Chapter 8: Microbes in Human Welfare

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: Which type of white blood cell is the most abundant in human blood and acts as a phagocyte during infection?
questions.explanation: Neutrophils make up about 60 to 65 percent of leucocytes and engulf bacteria. Lymphocytes handle immunity, eosinophils allergy and basophils release histamine.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 15: Body Fluids and Circulation

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: Which of the following is a surgical method of contraception in the male?
questions.explanation: Vasectomy removes or ties a small part of the vas deferens so sperms cannot reach the ejaculate. Tubectomy is the corresponding operation on the fallopian tubes in the female.
